sub_indicators.label: AI built at home
sub_indicators.subject: tech.ai
sub_indicators.text: Development of national / regional AI systems: AI built at home
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Continental AI Strategy asks that a country can manage its own data and AI, Local First: sovereign or regional computing, open national datasets and talent, taking part in continental AI infrastructure.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no AI model, dataset or AI computing is developed or hosted in the country.
A national AI model, dataset or AI computing facility is being built, piloted, or planned with a named builder, funder or site.
An AI model built in the country is released, a dataset made for AI is published, or AI computing is in service.
A facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators is in service in the country.
National AI computing, models or datasets are open to researchers, startups or other countries, with users named or counted.
